app.summary: Keeps a local shopping list and asks the owner's harness to plan meals from pantry context.

monetization.disclosure: The app is free. It does not sell data or charge for features. Hosted-provider usage, if the owner later points it at Claude/Codex/Cursor, is billed to the owner through Agent Harness, not through this app.

scopes.justification: Create one meal-planning session, inject pantry context, register list/add tools, and read that session's events until it finishes.

modes.notes: Uses the tower local model through POST /api/v1/sessions. No hosted-provider login.

provider_auth.usage_disclosure: This app runs AI tasks through your Agent Harness using the local model. It does not start Claude, Codex, or Cursor sessions in v1.0.0. It never asks for provider keys; those stay in harness settings.

data_collected.purpose: The meal prompt is sent only to the owner's daemon and is not stored by the app after the process exits.
The in-memory shopping list lives in the process until exit; it is not uploaded.

telemetry.description: No telemetry, crash reports, or analytics.

filesystem_access.purpose: No direct filesystem access. Pantry text is passed as session context through /api/v1.

handles_daemon_token.description: Reads HARNESS_TOKEN from the process environment and keeps it in memory. It is not logged, written to disk, or placed in URLs.

permission_diff.summary: First published version. Standard sessions scope only; local backend; no browser origin.

provider_policy_labels.notes: Local model is owner-hosted. No Anthropic/OpenAI/Cursor terms apply to this version.

review.notes: Ordinary helper matching the in-repo shopping list example pattern. Unsigned artifact is allowed at standard tier and must be hash-verified by the owner.
